text: Found-settlement hint chases a moving target: 'open ground ~11 east' then 2s later a new NPC Camp (Fortressshire) 87 away blocks it and the hint jumps to 170 north. Earlier '40 SE' was taken by Fortressburg. Over ~2200 ticks I followed 6 hints with 50 wood in hand and still could not found.

Inside own settlement, the Objective 7 panel (left) overlaps the settlement action button rows: 'Gather Wood', 'Purchase Food' and the progress line 'mbers 3/10 . Buildings 0/2' are drawn over each other and unreadable. Repro: found settlement, enter with E, build stall with B.

Pressed R (invite) next to Phoebe Lewis (Stranger, leader of Whitefield) after talking 3x: no status message or event at all, unlike 'There is no one within reach to invite' elsewhere. Also R is not listed in the brief's controls; only the objective text mentions it.
